response.overview: A student film inspired by “Funeral Parade of Roses”.  This is a story about personal growth. Have you ever lost yourself because of someone else? A crossdresser - Hiu Tung, enjoys dressing in women’s clothing but initially harbored a deep loathing for his own body. He enters a sexual relationship with a photographer named Ngan Yu and becomes infatuated with him, yet they can never become a 'real' couple. After realizing how much he had been hurt, Hiu Tung chooses to end the relationship, ultimately finding his true self through the aftermath of this connection. The director's own segments are added to the main clips, creating a sense of interweaving reality and illusion. Half of the story is based on the director's own personal experiences.
response.title: 你找到自己了嗎
